Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <c9adad36.01113...@posting.google.com>, David

Anderson-Dávila <dmd...@yahoo.com> writes:
>Do you mean for JOL? If so, where would I be able to find a complete
>specification for how to format the deck output for that purpose?

The only thing it needs is the name - everything else is a nicety. So
the name on one line, a few key points for vampires (disciplines etc.),
perhaps the type and requirement of a discipline card or something.

It is wrapped round with the LIBRARY and ENDREG commands (or CRYPT and
ENDREG). But simply having the text, one card per line, with
repetitions for each card (so instead of writing "8 Conditioning", you
have the card appear 8 times) is sufficient.

--
